تنافيت (form VI)
# تَنَافَيْتُ (tanāfaytu) /ta.naː.faj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَنَافَى (tanāfā)
# تَنَافَيْتَ (tanāfayta) /ta.naː.faj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَنَافَى (tanāfā)
# تَنَافَيْتِ (tanāfayti) /ta.naː.faj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَنَافَى (tanāfā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
